title: Threadline Responsive Messaging — Test Report
markdown:
# Threadline Responsive Messaging — Implementation Complete

## Test Results: 99/99 Passing

### Unit Tests (52 tests)

**ThreadlineMessage Protocol (6 tests)**
- Content, status, error, busy, session-rotated message construction
- Type discriminator distinguishes message types

**InboundMessageGate Replay Protection (6 tests)**
- New message passes, replay blocked
- Different messageIds from same sender both pass
- blockedByReplay metric tracked
- Edge case: empty messageId
- Replay blocked without session spawn

**ListenerSessionManager (40 tests)**
- Inbox write/read (4): entry creation, multiple entries, permissions, wake sentinel
- HMAC verification (4): valid entry, tampered entry, wrong HMAC, different auth token
- Ack tracking (3): empty start, acknowledge, unprocessed filtering
- Queue depth (3): empty, unacked count, decrease on ack
- Routing decisions (8): trusted/autonomous/verified/untrusted/long message/dead/rotating/overflow
- Rotation (6): threshold detection, file creation, archival, counter reset, sentinel
- Compaction (3): entry removal, HMAC preservation, ack file clearing
- Crash recovery (1): skip-list pattern for already-acked entries
- Bootstrap prompt (4): security preamble, default template, custom template, ordering
- State management (4): initial state, active/inactive, message count tracking

### Integration Tests (47 tests)

**E2E-1: Protocol Contract (1)** — All message types conform to ThreadlineMessage

**E2E-2: Replay Protection (4)** — First pass/replay block, different IDs, metrics, ordering

**E2E-3: Auto-Ack Behavior (3)** — Untrusted blocked, verified passes, trusted passes

**E2E-4: Trust-Gated Routing (8)** — Trusted→warm, autonomous→warm, verified→cold, untrusted→cold, long→cold, dead→cold, rotating→cold, overflow→cold

**E2E-5: Inbox Integrity (7)** — HMAC verification, tampered text/trust/fingerprint, manual injection, cross-token rejection, file permissions

**E2E-6: Crash Recovery (4)** — Unacked survive restart, acked not reprocessed, file persistence, partial ack handling

**E2E-7: Rotation (5)** — Threshold trigger, archive creation, counter reset, new messages to new inbox, sentinel file

**E2E-8: Compaction (3)** — Entry removal, HMAC preservation after compaction, ack file clearing

**E2E-9: Overflow Handling (4)** — Under threshold accepts, at threshold cold-spawns, acking reduces queue, messages NEVER dropped

**E2E-10: Bootstrap Prompt Security (3)** — Security preamble present, cannot be overridden by custom template, ordering enforced

**E2E-11: Full Lifecycle (5)** — Trusted through warm listener, untrusted through cold-spawn, overflow triggers cold-spawn, rotation with continued operation, replay protection across full pipeline

## Files Delivered

### New Files
-  — ThreadlineMessage protocol contract
-  — Authenticated inbox, HMAC, routing, rotation, compaction
-  — Protocol type tests
-  — Replay protection tests
-  — Listener session tests (40)
-  — Comprehensive e2e tests (47)

### Modified Files
-  — Replay protection (seen-messageId cache)
-  — ThreadlineConfig extended (autoAck, ackRateLimit, firstContactPolicy)
-  — ThreadlineRouter wiring, auto-ack, listener integration
-  — /threadline/status endpoint
-  — ListenerManager in options/context
-  — Phase 4h agent network prompt
